aspectran.description: | |Available commands for the Session Sample Shell Application: | | login Logs in with a username and role, and stores user info in the session. | Parameters: | username (required) - the name of the user to log in | role (optional) - the role of the user (default: USER) | Usage: | login | login --username=Aspectran --role=SUPER_ADMIN | | logout Logs out the current user by invalidating the session. | | whoami Shows information about the currently logged-in user. | | session-info Displays detailed metadata of the current session. |

bean.description: Sample activity bean that demonstrates login, logout, and session inspection using the shell's built-in SessionManager via Translet.getSessionAdapter().

translet.name: login
translet.description: | | Logs in with a username and role, and stores user info in the session. | | Parameters: | username (required) - the name of the user to log in | role (optional) - the role of the user (default: USER) | | Usage: | login | login --username=Aspectran --role=SUPER_ADMIN |

translet.name: logout
translet.description: | | Logs out the current user by invalidating the session. |

translet.name: whoami
translet.description: | | Shows information about the currently logged-in user. |

translet.name: session-info
translet.description: | | Displays detailed metadata of the current session. |
